description: This source file defines the CheckoutViewModel class for managing the checkout process in an Android e-commerce application. It handles form state, validation, applying coupons, submitting orders via repository interfaces, and managing UI state flows.

classes.name: CheckoutViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that manages the checkout screen, including form state, validation, coupon application, and order submission logic.

methods.name: prefillEmailIfAvailable
methods.description: Prefills the email field if the user's email is available from the cart repository.

methods.name: updateCustomerName
methods.description: Updates the customer name in the form state.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Updates the email field in the form state.

methods.name: updateAddressLine1
methods.description: Updates the address line 1 in the form state.

methods.name: updateCity
methods.description: Updates the city field in the form state.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the state field in the form state.

methods.name: updatePostalCode
methods.description: Updates the postal code in the form state.

methods.name: updateCountry
methods.description: Updates the country in the form state.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates the optional note in the form state.

methods.name: setMockPaymentSuccess
methods.description: Toggles the mock payment success flag, influencing order submission.

methods.name: updateCouponInput
methods.description: Updates the coupon input field in the form state.

methods.name: applyCouponFromCheckout
methods.description: Applies the entered coupon to the cart repository.

methods.name: removeCoupon
methods.description: Removes any applied coupon from the cart repository.

methods.name: clearSubmitError
methods.description: Clears any existing submission error message.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Validates form data, prepares order details, calls the order creation API, and manages success or error states.

methods.name: setForm
methods.description: Updates the form state and resets field errors.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the form fields and returns any errors.

methods.name: mapError
methods.description: Converts exceptions into user-facing error states.
